summary:
ORBIT is an offline-first astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform designed to help astronauts manage their physical and mental well-being during long-duration space missions.

Our solution collects physiological and behavioral health indicators, including heart rate, sleep duration, fatigue, stress, and mood. Unlike traditional health monitoring systems, ORBIT analyzes measurements against each astronaut’s personalized baseline, detects unusual changes and gradual health trends, and explains its findings with confidence indicators.

The platform also provides daily health check-ins, structured follow-up activities, and offline health reports that can be shared with medical teams when communication with Earth becomes available.

ORBIT addresses NASA’s challenge by empowering astronauts to monitor their health, recognize concerning changes, and make informed decisions when immediate medical assistance is unavailable.

Our mission is to make astronaut health monitoring more personalized, understandable, and reliable, supporting safer and more independent human space exploration.
